source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 世界人形机器人运动会
topics.why_hot: This is a first-of-its-kind sports event for humanoid robots, combining cutting-edge robotics with the familiar excitement of athletics.
topics.share_angle: Explain how humanoid robots are being tested through sports and why the event matters for the future of robotics.

topics.chinese_topic: 三台风共舞！都可能影响中国
topics.official_english: Three typhoons may all affect China as they converge
topics.why_hot: Typhoon forecasts directly affect daily life, travel, and disaster prevention, and three storms at the same time raises public concern.
topics.share_angle: Explain how multiple typhoons can form at once and what the forecasts mean for people in affected areas.

topics.official_english: Chinese e-bikes become a hit overseas
topics.why_hot: A Chinese export product suddenly gaining global popularity touches on trade, manufacturing, and green transport.
topics.share_angle: Break down why Chinese e-bikes are winning over overseas riders and what it says about green-tech exports.

topics.chinese_topic: 亲人离世存款查询难？三部门联合发布
topics.official_english: Three departments publish rules to ease access to deposits left by deceased relatives
topics.why_hot: Many families face practical difficulties handling a relative's savings after death; a new joint policy directly addresses a common pain point.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the new convenience measure and who it helps, with a simple explanation of how to use it.

topics.chinese_topic: 秒39！中国机器人打破博尔特百米成绩
topics.why_hot: The headline moment from a robot sports event shows machines matching or beating top human athletes, sparking awe and debate.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the result means for the robot games and what still separates robots from human sprinters.

topics.official_english: Global bond markets experience a sell-off
topics.why_hot: Bonds are fundamental to global finance, and a sell-off can signal shifting rate expectations or market stress.
topics.share_angle: Simplify what a bond sell-off is, why it matters for everyday money, and what to watch next.

topics.chinese_topic: 湖南祁东3人迷晕孩童系谣言
topics.official_english: Rumor that three people drugged children in Qidong, Hunan is false
topics.why_hot: Child safety rumors spread quickly and create panic; the official refutation is widely shared to correct misinformation.
topics.share_angle: Show why this kind of rumor keeps appearing online and how to verify local safety alerts before sharing.

topics.chinese_topic: 两女孩买三张火车票放零食 母亲回应
topics.official_english: Mother responds after two girls buy three train tickets for snacks
topics.why_hot: It triggers debate over whether buying extra train seats for luggage, snacks, or personal space is reasonable.
topics.share_angle: Lay out both sides of the train-ticket debate and explain the current rules on extra seats.
